trace: Core InputAddressMapping supplies one of twenty static text inputs and their equipment locations. Keyboard selection passes each input to key_code, which maps it to the native Bevy KeyCode; the source-declared keys and conversion branches are the same twenty unique strings.

The slot HUD serializes mapping.input through the wasm/JSON/DOM boundary, writes it to a data attribute and returns it in a tagged browser command. The browser command queue retains the decoded SlotHudPress input as a String; apply_slot_hud_press finds a matching mapping and ignores unknown strings. The selected mapping input is also retained as a static string in GrabSession.repeated_input.

The DOM and JSON boundary naturally require a representation; the open question is whether a suitably scoped existing or new binding identity should be admitted and retained on the Rust side instead of carrying an unrestricted String and reconstructing the mapping. Do not assume a shared identity with arbitrary keyboard shortcuts or adopt Bevy KeyCode into core without checking semantics and dependency direction.

trace: SlotCellView.join is Option<u64>; for items spanning more than one character location, slot_cell supplies entity.to_bits(). The typed view is serialized by serde_json and passed as JSON through the wasm HUD bridge.

The pinned Bevy 0.19.1 implementation combines entity generation in the high 32 bits with opaque nonzero index bits in the low 32; pinned nonmax 0.5.5 uses inverted raw index bits. Pinned serde_core forwards Some values, and serde_json forwards the u64 to itoa and writes its decimal digits as a JSON number.

The page JSON.parse produces JavaScript Number values, and drawSlots compares join values to join adjacent cells. Number values cannot distinguish all u64 integers. For illustration, Bevy representation bits 9007203549708284 and 9007203549708285 have generation 2,097,152 and valid nonzero index bits 0xfffffffc and 0xfffffffd, corresponding in this pinned representation to distinct raw indices 3 and 2. Binary64 nearest-even rounding maps both decimal integers to 9007203549708284.

If two distinct live spanning items with those identities are present in adjacent visible cells, their rounded join values can compare equal and draw a spurious visual connector. The shown comparison affects visual grouping; no effect on slot selection, authority, ordinary play or a real-world reachable state has been established.

standard_sources.observation: JSON.parse realizes JSON numbers as ECMAScript Number values.
Integers outside the safe range may share a Number value; the maximal safe integer is 2^53 - 1.
